spots.title: The raid's opening frame: the survivor's spawn on North Limestone, at the game's starting zoom
spots.why: KentuckyMap.Build's spawn (the sidewalk spot nearest the place's centre), facing along the street

spots.title: Downtown Lexington: the middle of the square, on West Main Street
spots.why: the place's own point in places.json (its OSM place node, which the square is built around), moved 2.1 m onto the nearest street

spots.title: The densest residential street: Wrenn Court, 3 homes within 30 m
spots.why: of the points every 6 m along the square's residential streets, the one with the most houses, apartments and trailers within 30 m

spots.title: The busiest intersection: East Vine Street / South Limestone / West Vine Street (4 ways in)
spots.why: the street node inside the square where the most, and the most important, streets meet (each scores its rank, double when it passes through)

spots.title: Green: park 'Courthouse Plaza', 5,476 m² inside the square
spots.why: the biggest park, cemetery, playground, pitch or golf course inside the square (grass, meadow and orchard count half)

spots.title: Parking: a parking, 4,181 m² inside the square
spots.why: the biggest parking area inside the square

spots.title: The square's edge: where East Vine Street leaves it (south), the playable map giving way to the scenery ring
spots.why: the best-ranked street crossing the square's edge, nearest its side's middle (how KentuckyMap ranks exits)
nothing of the kind in the square

spots.title: Landmark: the biggest building in the square, commercial 'Helix Parking Garage' (3,144 m² footprint)
spots.why: the largest footprint inside the square among churches, schools, warehouses, industrial, civic, hospital, retail, office, hotel and apartment buildings

costs.note: make 48.97 + switch on 7.18 ms; 1602 objects; destroy 2.97 ms; 3,000 rays 2.56 ms, 1075 hits, 3200.7 m
